sentences.en: I often heard him playing the melody on the trumpet.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到他用小号演奏那首旋律。

sentences.en: He blew in the trumpet and created a beautiful sound.
sentences.zh: 他吹响了喇叭，发出美妙的声音。

sentences.en: Elephants trumpet when they are scared and when they are angry.
sentences.zh: 大象害怕或生气时会发出喇叭声。

senses.zh: 喇叭，小号，喇叭声，喇叭手
吹喇叭发出喇叭似的声音
